quiz.question: Where should test files be located in relation to the source files?

answers.answer: In a mirrored structure under the test directory
In the same directory as the source files

quiz.question: Which of the following is the best test description?

answers.answer: test password validation on login screen
should display error message when password input is empty and login button is pressed

quiz.question: What makes a good test description?

answers.answer: It includes the function name being tested
By only seeing the test description, you can rewrite the test if it was removed
